  \caption[{Parameters of the electrode model.}]{Parameters of the

    \texttt{alpha} & \(\alpha\)           & 0.5     & ---                               & transfer coefficient \\
    \texttt{k0}    & \(k^0\)              & 0.1     & \si{\centi\metre\per\second}       & standard heterogeneous rate constant \\
